title_english: The Peacock and the King: The Great Contest of the Birds
description: Ancient fable describing how the golden peacock and the gathered birds of the forest held a contest to choose the king of birds.
full_translation: This story, this is a short story, not a long one.In our world, in every place and every way, there are birds. Among the group of birds, the Peacock is the king. One year, the other birds had to pay him taxes. He kept the heap (of money). The peacock used (the money)His tail was divided and tapering. His tail was long. At that time, there was nothing. His friends prepared a large pot of curry, the water boiling and bubbling. 'Whoever can (fly) down this side and come out again will be king. Whoever cannot do it, will not be king.'He was clever. He said, "Whoever can enter this hot water will be king,' But he thought, "I, the golden peacock, cannot enter the fire, I cannot go in. The king cannot go. I will die if I enter there.'A bird like this would be of value.  'I will be able to', he said and he flew up really high and came down quickly and struck the boiling water with his tail in this way. He divided the water and exclaimed: "Hey, I did it!."The King responded  "Hey, no, no, you didn't enter it. I could not see from above.
